name: AgentCompass
description: Route work with the built-in AgentCompass engine, read the tail of local Codex session logs (~/.codex and Cindy's codex-home) for quota, start matched child tasks in the parent project directory with bypassPermissions (Claude) / full-access (Codex, Pi), and collect exact results.
whenToUse: Delegate independent work through AgentCompass from a Cindy Claude, Codex or Pi session.

roll.description: Route the full task unchanged with the built-in AgentCompass engine (or a configured AgentCompass CLI) over this Cindy's live model catalog and start one exact catalog route. Reads the tail of local Codex session logs (~/.codex and Cindy's codex-home) for quota, and creates the child task in the parent's project directory with bypassPermissions (Claude) or full-access (Codex, Pi) regardless of the parent session's own mode. split and self answers start nothing. Requires experimental tasks capabilities and a matching configured plugin task directory. Returns an operation and a concrete status-tool call; no automatic callback. Never supply session_context yourself.

status.description: Collect the same operation. Reads durable host runs and paged messages; saves full output on disk and returns the exact final message summary. Call it until the run is terminal and messages_complete is true, then cleanup. Unknown delivery is reconciled from host runs, never resent.

stop.description: Cancel this plugin's run through Cindy's official scoped cancel API and wait briefly for the host to confirm. A run still reported as stopping is not terminated yet; collect status until terminal.

cleanup.description: Archive this plugin's task once every run on it is terminal and its messages are fully collected; otherwise refuse and name the tool to call. Without a host archive API, return the confirmed task ID for manual archiving in Cindy. Does not delete history or signal arbitrary processes.
